commentaire: The stage 6b of the GP de Beauce was initially planned to be a 60-km city course in Saint-Georges, but pouring rain made the city roads unsafe, causing several crashes and forcing the organisers to stop the race. The stage was decided not to count for the GC and shortened into a 30-km criterium. Therefore, no CQ-points are awarded.
titre: GP de Beauce, Stage 6b : Saint-Georges Criterium (30 km)
